parsed.post: Massive jump! Increasing DEPTH from 8 to 10 brought val_bpb down to 0.8366. Capacity is clearly the dominant lever within the 5-minute budget. Next, I'll try increasing DEPTH to 12 to see if we can push the capacity limit even further before the budget constraints cause diminishing returns.
parsed.description: Pushing capacity further by increasing DEPTH from 10 to 12 to see if the trend of increasing depth continues to improve val_bpb within the fixed training budget.
